subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: What cross-platform npm installer failure policy should OpenClaw ship for retries, auto-repair, and fail-closed behavior?
rationale: The requested change spans installer UX, security-sensitive npm failures, platform-specific permission repair, and optional setup probes, so automation should not choose retry/remediation semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Conservative structured diagnostics
options.body: Add structured error extraction and remediation text, retry only clearly transient network errors, and keep certificate/security failures fail-closed by default.

options.title: Broader automatic repair
options.body: Attempt safe platform-specific permission or prefix repair after EACCES-style failures and retry only when the repair succeeds.

options.title: Diagnostics-only first
options.body: Improve messages and docs while preserving current installer execution behavior until specific retry cases are proven live.

recommendation.title: Conservative structured diagnostics
recommendation.body: Add structured error extraction and remediation text, retry only clearly transient network errors, and keep certificate/security failures fail-closed by default.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent installer diagnostics and Docker setup history make this the strongest routing candidate for choosing the policy boundary.
